correctness.rationale: 2-adic sign-principal-unit splitting is exact and well-defined on every finite modulus. The logarithmic-exponential identities and strong displacement Lipschitz inequalities prove a sharp doubling valuation lemma. For the positive sign, first-step valuation is 2u; for the negative sign, first-step is r+1 and second-iterate valuation is 3r. Explicit state cardinalities in valuation layers give all cycle counts; all endpoint cases k=1,2 and fixed cases are treated. The verifier exhaustively reconstructs each finite graph k≤15 (32,767 states), not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete orbit spectrum for a natural modular self-exponentiation map answers the longer-cycle gap explicitly identified in the archival primary literature. Every point receives a closed valuation-based least period and the number of cycles at every length, including an invariant two-maximal-cycle phenomenon for every k≥6. The contribution goes beyond routine isolated fixed point counts, is uniformly infinite in k, and supplies arithmetic structure relevant to finite dynamics.
